description: Send a Reply - Send a reply to a specific message thread. Attachments are not supported on this connector — to send files, attach them via the SalesBlink web app.

attachments.description: NOT supported on this connector — providing file paths returns an error. Attach files via the SalesBlink web app instead.

messageId.description: The message ID to reply to

scheduled_time.description: Unix timestamp in ms to schedule the reply. If omitted or in the past, the reply is sent after a short delay.

selectedTimezone.description: IANA timezone to use when tzMode='custom'

tzMode.description: Timezone mode: 'sequence' uses the sequence timezone, 'custom' uses selectedTimezone

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: send_reply

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Send Reply
